title: "jira.edcpptp_comment"
description: "Every comment on every EDCPPTP issue, one row per comment per snapshot."
---

Every comment on every EDCPPTP issue, one row per comment per snapshot.

Each row is one comment on one issue (`key`) as it stood on one snapshot
`date`. Join to [`edcpptp`](edcpptp.qmd) on `key` and `date`.

`Keywords`: jira, edcpptp, partner transition, comments, notes, updates, blockers

## Provenance

Written by the `edcpptp-sync` Lambda in the same run as [`edcpptp`](edcpptp.qmd),
from each issue's full comment history. Comment authors are never fetched.

* **Updated**: Daily, at ~06:15 ET
* **Retention**: Pending. To be set at a retention meeting.
* **Steward**: EDCP Data and Research Team
* **Contact**: [Yinlin Zhang](mailto:yinlin.zhang@cds-snc.ca) (Data and Research team)
* **Location**: `s3://canadalogin-reporting-transformed/edcpptp/comments/`

## Fields

| Field Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| date | string | Partition key: the UTC date the Lambda ran (`YYYY-MM-DD`). |
| key | string | Jira issue key, e.g. `EDCPPTP-770`. |
| comment_id | string | Jira's ID for the comment. |
| created | string | ISO 8601 timestamp when the comment was posted. |
| updated | string | ISO 8601 timestamp when the comment was last edited. `created` if never edited. |
| body | string | The comment text, extracted from Atlassian Document Format (ADF) to plain text. |
| internal | boolean | Is the comment hidden from customers? Always `false`. |
| fetched_at | string | UTC timestamp when the Lambda wrote this row (`YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`). |

## Notes

**Every snapshot repeats every comment.** Like `edcpptp`, each partition holds
the full comment history of every issue, so a comment appears once per
snapshot. Filter to one `date` before counting.
